The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: having little money.

notes: จน is one of those versatile Thai words that changes function completely depending on context. As an adjective, it means poor. As a conjunction, it means 'until' or 'so... that'.

senses.definition: Having little money or few possessions; lacking the means for a comfortable standard of living.

examples.text: เขาทำงานหนักแต่ยังจนอยู่
examples.translation: He works hard but is still poor.
examples.emotion: sympathetic and tired, stating a harsh reality

senses.definition: Up to a point in time or space; until.

examples.text: ฉันรอคุณจนดึก
examples.translation: I waited for you until late.
examples.emotion: a bit exhausted and slightly reproachful, showing how long the wait was

senses.definition: To such a degree or extent that a certain result occurs.

examples.text: เขากินจนอิ่ม
examples.translation: He ate until he was full.
examples.emotion: satisfied and relaxed after a good meal
